title: Sol
description: Though he was revered as a wise and respected Jedi Master of the Order, Sol was not without his flaws. Because of his compassionate nature, he took Osha Aniseya as a Padawan after the tragic fires on Brendok. Unfortunately, she left her training behind. He took Jecki Lon as a Padawan after, and that set them both down a path towards a confrontation with a fearsome dark sider...
